# Gantt Chart

```mermaid
gantt
    title Project Timeline
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    section Design
    Design Phase    :a1, 2024-01-01, 30d
    section Development
    Development     :a2, after a1, 60d
    section Testing
    Testing         :a3, after a2, 20d
    section Release
    Release         :a4, after a3, 10d
```
